about: Computer-made spectrograms for the sound book: synthesized from published averages with a Klatt-style formant synthesizer (speakup/synth.py), not recordings. Built by scripts/build_synth_pictures.py.

tolerance.formant: within 10% or 100 Hz, whichever is larger

query: Find a picture with speakup.synth_book.lookup(sound, sex, age_months) or by hand: by_sound (or variants) gives the item, age_bands the band (no band covers the age: use the nearest older band and say so), and the picture is file <item>-<group>.png with group from groups.

items.title: /i/ in "heed"
items.look_for: F1 very low and F2 very high, close under F3. The highest F2 of any vowel.

items.title: /ɪ/ in "hid"
items.look_for: Like /i/ but a little more open: F1 a bit higher and F2 a bit lower than in /i/.

items.title: /eɪ/ in "hayed"
items.look_for: F1 mid and F2 high, gliding up toward /ɪ/ at the end.

items.title: /ɛ/ in "head"
items.look_for: F1 mid to high and F2 fairly high: between /ɪ/ and /æ/.

items.title: /æ/ in "had"
items.look_for: F1 high and F2 fairly high, wide apart from F1. The jaw is open.

items.title: /ɑ/ in "hod"
items.look_for: F1 highest of all vowels and F2 low, so F1 and F2 sit close together near the bottom.

items.title: /ɔ/ in "hawed"
items.look_for: F1 high and F2 low, both a little lower than in /ɑ/ (rounded lips).

items.title: /oʊ/ in "hoed"
items.look_for: F1 mid and F2 low, gliding lower toward /ʊ/ at the end.

items.title: /ʊ/ in "hood"
items.look_for: F1 fairly low and F2 low to mid: like /u/ but more open.

items.title: /u/ in "who'd"
items.look_for: F1 low and F2 low (rounded lips, back tongue), F3 well above.

items.title: /ʌ/ in "hud"
items.look_for: F1 mid to high and F2 in the middle: a central vowel with F3 at its normal height.

items.title: /ə/ in "a-dah"
items.look_for: A short, weak vowel with formants near the middle of the speaker's range.

items.title: /ɝ/ in "heard"
items.look_for: F3 held low, close to F2, through the whole vowel. The key r sign.

items.title: /aɪ/ in "hide"
items.look_for: A glide from /ɑ/ (F1 high, F2 low) to /ɪ/ (F1 low, F2 high): F2 rises steeply.

items.title: /aʊ/ in "how'd"
items.look_for: A glide from /ɑ/ to /ʊ/: F1 and F2 both fall.

items.title: /ɔɪ/ in "hoyd"
items.look_for: A glide from /ɔ/ (F2 low) to /ɪ/ (F2 high): F2 rises steeply.

items.title: /p/ in /ɑpɑ/
items.look_for: Silence, a weak burst spread over low frequencies, then a long stretch of aspiration noise before voicing (long VOT).

items.title: /b/ in /ɑbɑ/
items.look_for: A weak voice bar in the closure, a weak burst, and voicing almost at once after it (short VOT).

items.title: /t/ in /ɑtɑ/
items.look_for: Silence, a burst strongest at high frequencies, then aspiration before voicing (long VOT).

items.title: /d/ in /ɑdɑ/
items.look_for: A short voice bar, a high-frequency burst, and voicing right after it (short VOT). F2 starts near 1700 to 1800 Hz in adults.

items.title: /k/ in /ɑkɑ/
items.look_for: A burst with one compact mid-frequency peak; F2 and F3 start close together (the velar pinch). Long VOT.

items.title: /ɡ/ in /ɑɡɑ/
items.look_for: Like /k/ (compact mid-frequency burst, F2 and F3 close) but with a short VOT.

items.title: /f/ in /ɑfɑ/
items.look_for: Faint, flat noise across the whole range with no strong band. Easy to miss.

items.title: /v/ in /ɑvɑ/
items.look_for: Faint, flat noise like /f/ with a voice bar underneath.

items.title: /θ/ in /ɑθɑ/
items.look_for: Faint, flat noise like /f/: the picture alone cannot tell /θ/ from /f/.

items.title: /ð/ in /ɑðɑ/
items.look_for: Faint, flat noise with voicing, often very short.

items.title: /s/ in /ɑsɑ/
items.look_for: Strong noise that starts above about 3 to 4 kHz and is darkest high up, for a child often above 6 kHz.

items.title: /z/ in /ɑzɑ/
items.look_for: Like /s/ (strong high noise) with a voice bar at the bottom.

items.title: /ʃ/ in /ɑʃɑ/
items.look_for: Strong noise with a clear lower edge and its peak in the middle range (about 2.5 to 5 kHz), lower than /s/.

items.title: /ʒ/ in /ɑʒɑ/
items.look_for: Like /ʃ/ (mid-range noise peak) with a voice bar at the bottom.

items.title: /h/ in /ɑhɑ/
items.look_for: Noise with the next vowel's formant bands already in it, and no voice bar.

items.title: /tʃ/ in /ɑtʃɑ/
items.look_for: Silence, a burst, then /ʃ/-like noise that starts abruptly.

items.title: /dʒ/ in /ɑdʒɑ/
items.look_for: A short voice bar, a burst, then short /ʃ/-like noise with voicing.

items.title: /m/ in /ɑmɑ/
items.look_for: A weak, smooth murmur with energy only at the bottom (about 250 to 350 Hz) and sharp edges into the vowels.

items.title: /n/ in /ɑnɑ/
items.look_for: Like /m/: a low murmur with sharp edges. The place shows mainly in the vowel transitions.

items.title: /ŋ/ in /ɑŋɑ/
items.look_for: A low murmur like /m/ and /n/; F2 and F3 come together at the vowel edge as for /k/ and /g/.

items.title: /w/ in /ɑwɑ/
items.look_for: F1 and F2 both very low (F2 lower than in /u/) while F3 stays high: a very wide F3-F2 gap.

items.title: /l/ in /ɑlɑ/
items.look_for: F3 stays high, far above F2, and the bands start and stop abruptly at the edges.

items.title: /ɹ/ in /ɑɹɑ/
items.look_for: F3 dips low toward F2 between the vowels, then rises again. F2 stays moderate, not very low.

items.title: /j/ in /ɑjɑ/
items.look_for: F1 very low and F2 very high, near /i/, gliding into the vowel.

items.title: /ɹ/ in "rabbit"
items.look_for: At the start, F3 is low and close to F2, then rises into the vowel. A narrow F3-F2 gap is the sign of a good r.

items.title: "rabbit" said as "wabbit" (gliding)
items.look_for: Gliding: F3 stays high at the start instead of dipping, F2 is very low, and the F3-F2 gap is very wide.

items.title: "rabbit" with a derhotacized (distorted) r
items.look_for: Distorted r: F3 drops only part of the way, so the gap is between a good r and a [w].

items.title: /ɑsɑ/ with a interdental lisp
items.look_for: Interdental lisp: weak, flat noise like /θ/, with no strong dark band high up.

items.title: /ɑsɑ/ said as a dentalized /s/
items.look_for: Dentalized /s/: the noise peak is a little lower and flatter than a good /s/.

items.title: /ɑsɑ/ with a lateral lisp
items.look_for: Lateral lisp: the noise peak is low (about 3 to 4 kHz) and spread out, closer to /ʃ/ than to /s/.

items.title: /ɑsɑ/ said as a palatal /s/
items.look_for: Palatal /s/: the noise peak moves down toward the /ʃ/ range, below about 5 to 6 kHz in a child.

items.title: "had" with hypernasality
items.look_for: Hypernasality: an extra low nasal band under F1, and F1 weaker and wider than in the oral vowel.

klatt1980.text: Klatt, D. H. (1980). Software for a cascade/parallel formant synthesizer. Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 67(3), 971-995.

klatt1990.text: Klatt, D. H., & Klatt, L. C. (1990). Analysis, synthesis, and perception of voice quality variations among female and male talkers. Journal of the Acoustical Society of America, 87(2), 820-857.
